text:
mari: Quick plan note — launching a small private pilot with staggered waves. need intake fields, acceptance gates, and minimal legal for partners

alex_r: Prefer two-step intake: quick interest then technical eligibility. reduces churn.

june: +1. Step A = contact, use-case, pilot goals. Step B = infra (VPC/on-prem), expected QPS, SSO/KMS, and allowed log level.

mari: For allowed logs include choices: none, metrics-only, redacted traces, full traces (requires DPA).

alex_r: Add a "support runway" field (dev-days) so eng can budget onboarding.

june: Also capture feedback cadence: weekly first month then biweekly. partners to provide 20-50 prompt samples for quality checks.

tom: Legal: any PII in logs needs a DPA and explicit partner consent. I'll draft a one-page DPA summary and NDA template.

mari: Acceptance gates per wave: infra provisioned, onboarding checklist done, two smoke runs within latency SLO. Wave sizes: wave1=3, wave2=6-8.

alex_r: Require a rollback plan — fallback routing to stable model if quality/latency degrades. Include as safety net in intake.

mari: Timeline: intake + DPA draft by EOW, wave1 invite list by next Tue, onboarding runbook by next Fri. owners?

june: onboarding docs + checklist = mine.

alex_r: obs toggles and minimal partner config YAML = mine.

tom: DPA one-pager + NDA = mine.

mari: dp-bot create spreadsheet & calendar placeholders when list ready

dp-bot: created sheet at /product/pilots/private-pilot-stub.csv and board "private-pilot-staggered". invited Mari, Alex_R, June, Tom. :white_check_mark:

mari: please each add 3 must-have intake fields to the sheet by EOD tomorrow. reconvene Thurs 10am to finalize.
